description: sheets.spreadsheets.sheets.copyTo: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/sheets/{sheetId}:copyTo. Copies a single sheet from a spreadsheet to another spreadsheet. Returns the properties of the newly created sheet. Body: vendor CopySheetToAnotherSpreadsheetRequest JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Sheets Copy To to copies a single sheet from a spreadsheet to another spreadsheet in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/sheets/{sheetId}:copyTo). Send the vendor CopySheetToAnotherSpreadsheetRequest body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.
